articleTitle: How to Plan for Aging Without Kids (and With a Disabled Dependent)
imageHeadline: Planning for two futures when family isn't the plan
imageSubtext: Legal, financial, and support strategies for solo caregivers aging with dependents
pinTitle: How to Plan for Aging Without Kids (and With a Disabled Dependent) | Solo Aging Guide
pinDescription: When you're caring for a disabled relative and have no adult children to coordinate your own future care, you need a different framework. Legal documents, support networks, and financial strategies that account for both of you—practical steps to start before 45.
